name: Frances Tiafoe
intro: Frances Tiafoe is a high-energy American from Maryland. Fans call him Big Foe. He loves a loud crowd, and New York loves him back.
story: Frances grew up at a tennis center near Washington, D.C. His dad worked there, and the family lived there for years. He and his twin brother started lessons at age four. He has reached the semifinals here twice. On Friday he won in straight sets, so he plays again Sunday.

funFacts.text: He has a twin brother named Franklin. Franklin played college tennis too.
His parents came to America from Sierra Leone, a country in West Africa.
He started hitting tennis balls at age four.
His favorite childhood food is peanut butter stew. A famous chef cooked it for him.
If he wins, he wants to eat Oreos, Hershey's, and milkshakes.
He is a huge basketball fan. He even played in an NBA celebrity game.
He cheers for all the Washington, D.C. teams, like the Wizards and Commanders.

watchFor: Watch his forehand: he lifts his elbow way up high before he swings!
